Name: More Convenient Shop Inventory
Author: NoraCharles
Description:
This mod edits 5 shops that normally have rotating stock (different items on different days of the week) and makes those items part of the permanent stock (sold every day). It does [b]not[/b] change any other purchase limitations that may apply to specific items, or add any new items to the shops.

The affected shops are: [b]Carpenter, Desert Trader, Island Trader, Krobus, Oasis[/b]
Each shop can be individually enabled/disabled in the config settings.

[b]REQUIREMENTS & COMPATIBILITY[/b]

[list]
[*]Requires Content Patcher
[*]Only for Stardew 1.6
[*]Should be compatible with mods that add items to shops (as long as they are not overwriting the vanilla shop inventory) but it will not affect any modded items (e.g. if a mod adds an item that is only sold on a specific day of the week)
[/list][b]
